description: A forward operating base commander must approve the room assignments and opening controls for a temporary support annex containing an equipment-issue desk and a protected medical-records desk.

shared_context.S1: The temporary support annex has two available rooms, East and West, and both rooms can be made ready tomorrow morning.
shared_context.S2: The annex will contain an equipment-issue desk and a protected medical-records desk.
shared_context.S3: Col. Mercer must approve the room assignments and the controls required before either desk opens.
shared_context.S4: At the routine morning move-board, Col. Mercer asks the facilities and signal officers to report any room, infrastructure, or opening requirements before the approval is signed.

PF1.text: The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. Facilities measured that East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms; Maj. Alvarez verified the ratings this morning, but the floor-load note has not yet been added to the relocation worksheet.

PF2.text: The protected medical-records desk can connect to the required isolated network only through the fiber patch panel in East Room. The signal technician is booked to certify that connection from 0900 to 1000 tomorrow; Lt. Okafor received the booking confirmation this morning, but it is not yet on the annex opening checklist.

acceptance_conditions: The equipment-issue desk must be assigned to West Room because its stocked cabinet exceeds East Room's floor rating.
The medical-records desk must be assigned to East Room because its isolated network connection is available there.
The medical-records network certification must be scheduled for 0900-1000 tomorrow.
A floor-load verification commitment for the equipment-issue desk must be recorded.
A protected-network certification commitment for the medical-records desk must be recorded.
The room constraints must be cited in the commander's justification.

content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'floor_load_verification' and c['target'] == 'equipment_issue_desk' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'protected_network_certification' and c['target'] == 'medical_records_desk' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The 1,100-kilogram stocked cabinet changes the equipment-issue desk assignment from either available room to West, and changes the plan by requiring a floor-load verification.

The East Room fiber-panel location changes the medical-records desk assignment to East and the technician booking changes its certification window to exactly 0900-1000, requiring a protected-network certification commitment.
